overrides.tagline: One product, every store's price, side by side
overrides.summary: A price comparison website that aggregates product data from multiple e-commerce platforms into one view — built with React and styled with Tailwind CSS.
description: Prices for the same product differ from store to store, and checking each one by hand is slow.
PricePulse aggregates product data from multiple e-commerce platforms and presents it in one comparison, with a clean React and Tailwind interface.

features.title: Multi-store data
features.desc: Product data gathered from several e-commerce platforms.

features.title: Side-by-side comparison
features.desc: One view per product with every store's price.

features.title: Clean interface
features.desc: React and Tailwind CSS for a fast, simple UI.

challenge: Shoppers compare prices across several stores by hand. PricePulse brings those prices into one place.
